Sketch: `/tmp/period-sketch-astra.md`.

Recommend projecting existing detail responses into the selected period, adding only `period`. Preserve all three authoritative headline totals in their existing locations; scope every other aggregate and declaration list before computation.

Canonical Rust period/context resolves private-construction registration windows. Rankings SQL accepts both bounds and filters before grouping/top-ten. Frontend selects an existing headline without recalculation and preserves period through shared URL helpers.

Main risks: default-detail semantics change to current term; old fixtures require coordinated updates; period changes must reset local history dates and pagination. Nested selected envelopes add substantial consumer churn without improving calculation ownership.
